description: Connect ChatGPT to your Maeve Social workspace to review scheduled content and analytics, create platform-aware drafts, organize Media Room assets and tasks, configure inbox auto-replies, schedule content, and publish with explicit confirmation. Maeve supports Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn, LinkedIn Pages, X, Threads, YouTube, Pinterest, and Google Business Profile. Content creation is draft-first, and high-impact actions are protected by confirmation. Requires a Maeve Social account.

defaultPrompt: Show me what content is scheduled across my workspace this week.
Review my recent social performance and summarize which content performed best.
Create a draft for my next campaign using my workspace strategy and connected platform requirements.
